description: This file provides a TypeScript module for interacting with a configuration API, including functions for managing environment files, schemas, agent configurations, packages, and lifecycle operations, along with custom error handling and utility functions.

classes.name: ConfigurationApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for API errors related to configuration operations, including optional HTTP status code.

methods.name: addAuthHeaders
methods.description: Adds authentication headers, including API key, to fetch request options.

methods.name: fetchWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs fetch with a timeout, aborting the request if it exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles fetch responses, parsing JSON on success or throwing detailed errors on failure.
